# Support

## Getting Help

- Open a bug report for reproducible defects.
- Open a feature request for enhancements.
- For security issues, use private security reporting.

## What to Include

- Environment details (OS, Python version, Node version).
- Backend and frontend startup commands used.
- Logs and screenshots with sensitive data removed.
- Exact steps to reproduce.

## Service Expectations

- Community support is best-effort.
- Critical production-impacting issues should include severity and business impact.
